about: The room page's display settings (which languages a message shows, and the chat text size) to hooks/use-display-prefs.ts. The table holds for the tree of the commit that added it (git log --diff-filter=A -- scripts/step6/tables/web-display-prefs-hook.json): later moves take more lines out of the page. From the repo root, with that commit checked out in <folder>: node scripts/step6/web-move-check.mjs scripts/step6/tables/web-display-prefs-hook.json --root <folder>, and node scripts/step6/hook-order.mjs "apps/web/app/room/[roomId]/page.tsx" --root <folder> --base 61a1910 --allow scripts/step6/tables/web-display-prefs-hook.hooks.json --strict

apps/web/app/room/[roomId]/page.tsx: const { showEnglish, showJapanese, showRomaji, chatSize, toggleDisplay, pickChatSize } = useDisplayPrefs(participantId);
apps/web/hooks/use-display-prefs.ts: import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
return { showEnglish, showJapanese, showRomaji, chatSize, toggleDisplay, pickChatSize };
